intro: Example placeholder for Austin, Texas. This introduction is sample copy for readers who like an unreliable mind more than a chase scene. Austin rain has a way of making MoPac feel longer and South Congress louder, and a story about a count that will not hold still fits that kind of night. Streetlight Math is the free read embedded here: Ryan Kane counts nine streetlights, then ten, then nine again, and he does not know which number to trust. The parking lot is not an Austin lot. This page is the Austin part, written only for this URL, for people searching for a free thriller where memory slips. HUNTED, the Book 1 prequel, is the longer book, and it is free on BookFunnel. Fractured Ground is the Kindle follow-up. Reviewers who want book three early will find Digital Ascent waiting on BookSprout. The short story's canonical home is the free read page, so search engines can tell the story from this city page. Lady Bird Lake does not appear in the fiction. It appears here because Austin readers know what the city feels like when the count in your head will not settle. Houston and Dallas are linked for a different mood, not a rewritten copy of this paragraph.
